_comment: O4-ISSUE's ATTRIBUTION DATA -- the hand-authored half of tools/gen_order_issue_inventory.py.
The inventory itself is DERIVED: every one of the order-issue surface's entries gets its owner
from its own ledger row (translated by this domain, or stays-original with settle evidence), so
nothing about the 113 is written here. What IS written here is the part no ledger can answer --
the accessors of the order CONTAINER's regions that are not members of this surface at all. Those
belong to other subsystems, so somebody has to say WHICH item owns each, and that claim is a
THE NEGATIVE ARM DEPENDS ON THIS FILE BEING SHORT. Every external accessor of an order region
must appear below with an `owner` item and a `why`; an accessor that appears in the census and not
here FAILS the check. So the way a new external writer gets accepted is that somebody writes down
who owns it -- which is exactly the property O4-ISSUE's done_when asks for, and the reason this is
a data file with a gate rather than a paragraph in a doc.
_region_prefix_why: The order container's regions, selected by prefix rather than by a hand list so a region added to
the registry later cannot be silently outside the audit. Measured 2026-08-28: twelve regions --
QUEUE / STAGING / PENDING and their three counters, SCRATCH_ARGS, SEQ_ID_BY_PLAYER and the four
ACK_VOICE_* members. O4-ISSUE's done_when says `all four order regions`, written when only four
were known to be held; the prefix covers those four and eight more, which is strictly stronger.

why: The map/session defaults filler, which zeroes the three order counters at map load. It is an
INIT-ONLY write, not an ownership claim -- it never reads them back and never runs during a
tick -- so this is a SCHEDULED hold with a named owner, not an unattributed accessor.
THE OWNER CHANGED 2026-08-28 (user's call) AND THIS ENTRY SAID MAP-LOAD UNTIL 2026-08-30.
It is `map_*` by NAME and a per-new-game SIM reset by BEHAVIOUR: 19 regions -- the three order
counters, ctrl groups, storage/power/pop stats, turrets, labs, mines, productions, soldiers --
called from llm_strat_mode_init and map_ReadMap_pre. MAP-LOAD closed 2026-08-28 with the verdict
ALL 25 EXCEPTED, none owned, and excluded this function from its scope through
writer_dispositions.json's `owned_elsewhere` rather than adjudicating it. SIM-RESID adopted it,
and its own done_when names this hold in as many words: the three counters must measure zero
external writers, which is O4-ISSUE's remaining hold. 1,156 B at 0x45603e; 35 entries in
docs/patching-surface.md must be re-derived against our body when it is translated.
Still explicitly out of scope for THIS domain since decomposition (docs/orders-issue-closure.md
Sect. 10) -- the owner moved, the scope boundary did not.
NOTE THE COUNT. O4-ISSUE's done_when says `map_FillDefaults's two counter writes`; the census
measures THREE (queue, staging and pending). The clause was written from the plan and the
measurement disagreed with it, which is the same way its sibling clause named the wrong fourth
SEQ_ID writer -- see O4B's progress. Three is the measured number.
